name: codex-delegate
description: Use Codex Native Subagents only when delegation improves the task, with clear bounded Luna execution, Sol judgment, read-heavy Terra investigation, and selective independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive delegation for reliable everyday development.
interface.longDescription: Codex Delegate keeps the current session in control and uses additional native Subagents only when they add concrete value. Luna Max handles clear repeatable bounded evidence and implementation whose material behavior is already decided, Sol High handles demanding material judgment and judgment-coupled writing, Terra XHigh handles bounded read-heavy technical investigation and evidence synthesis after semantics stabilize, and a fresh Sol Advisor reviews only final artifacts that genuinely require independent assurance.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-delegate to complete this development task and delegate only when extra native compute adds value.
Use $codex-delegate to implement this change with bounded execution and material judgment only where needed.
Use $codex-delegate to review this change and add independent review only when the final artifact warrants it.
